type TimestampRoleOf<S> (internal, src/schema.ts) = S extends Schema<infer _F, infer T> ? T extends Record<string, TimestampRoleSpec<infer _G>> ? Extract<keyof T, string> : never : never

interface TimestampRoleSpec<F extends FieldsObject = FieldsObject> (internal, src/schema.ts)
  readonly default?: true | undefined
  readonly field: keyof F & string
  readonly unit: TimestampUnit

type TimestampUnit (internal, src/schema.ts) = "ns" | "us" | "ms" | "s" | "samples"

type TimestampsConfig<F extends FieldsObject> (internal, src/schema.ts) = Record<string, TimestampRoleSpec<F>>

type TrajectoryLayout (internal, src/schema.ts) = "interleaved" | "planar"

type TrajectoryOrder (internal, src/schema.ts) = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4

type TrajectoryOverflowFallback (internal, src/schema.ts) = "hold" | "linear" | "saturate"

  readonly sampleCount: number
  readonly velocityClamp?: number | undefined
